DN clinic did not only save my holiday but also performed very good! Immediately after landing in Phuket, the worst tooth ache you could ever imagine started to appear - I had to contact 10000 clinics but no one was able to help until one of them finally recommended DN clinic to me, as they were the only ones with a root canal specialist. They gave me an appointment within 1 hour. Everything on the appointment day was great, everyone wass friendly and I had the feeling they really take time to help me and to not just pass me on.
Today after 4 weeks  I had a follow up with my local doc in Austria, and he was more than stunned about how professional and clean the root canal treatment was carried out. Even though it was on the pricier side, I still Thank you so much for helping me and the brilliant job!!
The crowns are very expensive and the warranty is only 2 years. After 4, I'm already do same crowns again. In Vietnam cheaper in 5 times and warranty 10 years. Some place have a lifetime

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Dr. Nan, and I can't recommend her highly enough! From the moment I walked into her office, I felt welcomed and at ease. The staff was friendly and efficient, making the check-in process a breeze.

Dr. Nan is not only incredibly knowledgeable but also takes the time to explain each procedure in detail, ensuring I fully understood what to expect. Her gentle approach and genuine care for her patients make a significant difference, alleviating any anxiety I had about my dental visit.

The office is equipped with the latest technology, and I appreciated how she emphasizes preventative care and tailors her recommendations to fit my individual needs. The level of attention and concern she shows is rare to find!

Overall, I left with a brighter smile and a newfound confidence in my dental health. If you're looking for a dentist for any reason, Dr. Nan is the one to see! Without thinking twice

I had very uncomfortable experiences at this clinic. During a visit, I was surprised to see the receptionist spit into a rubbish bin behind the desk. I’ve never seen that in a medical setting before.

The dentist seemed dismissive when I mentioned that a tooth they had worked on was painful again. They said it wasn’t their previous work and came across as though they were doing me a favor by fixing it. I was in pain, so I just went ahead with the treatment.

I also noticed a stack of completed “new patient” forms left out in plain view on the side of the reception desk where people stand to check in. These included full names, ID numbers, phone numbers, addresses, and medical details. Anyone walking in the front door could easily see them. As someone who values privacy—and is currently under protective services—this really shocked and worried me.

The waiting area also didn’t feel clean. The sofa bench where patients sit had visible staining and seemed heavily worn. No water or anything was offered while waiting. I also noticed that prices weren’t posted anywhere, and we were only given verbal quotes at each visit. I’m not sure if this is standard practice or simply due to how the front desk is run, but it felt unclear.

The treatment ended up taking several visits for an issue I thought would be resolved in one. At the end of the second session, I was told I’d need to come back again, which surprised me. After all of that, the problem still isn’t resolved, and I’ll be going to another clinic to have the work reviewed.

My partner had really encouraged me to seek treatment because I was in pain, and now we’ve spent a lot of money and time—and I’m still in pain. Due to the dismissive attitude I experienced when trying to explain concerns, and the general lack of clarity or comfort throughout the process, I don’t feel comfortable coming back.

It's great Doctor. But one thing happened today and It wasn't necessary.  I'll explain. Yesterday book for cleaning, asking for price. Dentist say it is between 1000-1500
Went for a cleaning today. But got charged 2000. I asked why and they say my teeth dirty. I think it is the reason why I went for a cleaning. So why not tell price between 1000 and 2000  straight. Then I will know it can be 2000. Then she said ok 1500. I paid
And when I left and say good bye they just avoid eyes contact and didn't even say goodbye back. So I'm not sure what to think about it.
The work the dentist did was very professional.  It is my second Time going there. And probably the last time as I felt really disrespectful to not say good bye back. Typical
I felt the front desk had problem dealing  with foreigner  And I read a lot a comment saying the same.

Dr Nan, is fantastic, some people have to remember that they are in Thailand and appointments don’t always run on time, but you still get 100 % top quality care and treatment when your turn comes around.
Dr Nan speaks good English and is bright and cheerful.
My last dental treatment was over a couple of days, (GOLD ) veneers and a 3 tooth bridge.
Dr Nan stayed open PAST their closing time to ensure that my teeth were completed as I had a short travel stay in Phuket.
This is the kind of service you will be hard pressed to find anywhere else.
I have been using Dr. Nan now for over 6 years and she is the only Dentist I trust to provide Me with advanced Dental work.
Highly recommend this establishment for your Dental needs whilst in Phuket.

Dr Nan has golden hands 🙏🏻💎 I had also experience with other doctors, they are great as well 👍  Anesthesia is always good, you don’t feel pain. And they give a numbing agent before the shot.

Thank you for best dental service in Phuket.

Your loyal client

One of the best dental treatment experiences of my life. I am very grateful to dentist Thitiya Phongtanapanich. She was able to remove caries on wisdom teeth, while other doctors from Russia and Estonia said that they could not, since the teeth were located too far from the mouth. And Dr. Thitiya easily cured two wisdom teeth and made anesthesia amazingly painless, that I didn’t even realize that she had given an injection. The treatment was quick, easy and painless. I recommend!

Very good service.  I highly recommend.  I was there for a tooth pain. My wisdom tooth had to be removed but their specialist was not available. They however booked an appointment for me with another specialist nearby for the same day. Everything went perfectly fine.
I’ve been to this clinic 3 times, root canal, cavity and cleaning. All done very professionally. Recommend

Hello, we are Americans living in China. My wife just had a root canal done here and she said she didn't feel a thing and they were super gentle! They even use a numbing agent before giving the shot! The price was also very reasonable especially compared to the US.

I had a broken bridge and need urgent help. Even they were fully booked they managed to get me an appointment on the same day. I was impressed how quickly and professional they fixed my problem. Very recommendable....👏👍 …

The doctor replaced the filling well.

Unfortunately, I can’t recommend dental cleaning here because it was rather painful. Not like in other clinics where I had this procedure
If you ever need someone to take good care of your teeth, this is the place to go, they are professional, super gentle, and the price is very reasonable :-)
The receptionist was very, very rude. On phone she wouldn’t have even bothered explaining or inform I don’t know if it’s just with foreigners or with everyone.
Good service. One English speaking dentist. Not always the fastest, but a good deal at 800 baht for a cleaning.
Service is good,but front desk reception is very rude to foreigners.
All the root treatment that i did with them now all rotten
Great honest service from K.Nan and her staff.
Polite price and nice quality.

⚠️ The clinic is closed till the May 30th

Keep it in mind planning a treatment here

I had nerves removed and root canals done in other teeth. They do a great job. Four root canals cost 12,000 baht. They saw me the next day. It's not a fancy repair, but the doctor who treated me was great.

I had a tooth extracted at this clinic about two years ago. Now I've decided to get an implant. And I don't understand why your specialists didn't remove some of the material from my gums???? I took the first x-ray at your dental office after the extraction. I took the second x-ray now. You saw that there was something left. Why did you ignore this? Now I need to remove it from my gums before the implant placement, then do some other procedures, and only then can I get the implant. This means additional time and money. I'm waiting for an explanation and I don't recommend this place to anyone. After all, I'm now wondering whether I even needed to remove the tooth. After all, they told me to remove it, and I trusted them, thinking the specialist knew their job!

I'm giving 3 stars only for the head doctor. Because of her energy and professionalism.
Otherwise, I can't recommend the clinic for several reasons:
- the clinic's hygiene leaves much to be desired (it's dirty);
- the staff comes and goes during procedures, doing their own thing, chatting like they're at a market.
This is a clinic, not a market.

I came in with severe pain for three days. I had a root canal abscess under a crown. The pain relief was excellent, and all four canals were cleaned and treated in 50 minutes. The doctor kept me updated on the procedure and communicated with me. Thank you to the doctor, nurses, and staff.

Thank you to Dr. Thitiya and her staff! I had a complicated case, and this clinic's endodontist was recommended to me by other clinics in Phuket, and for good reason. The clinic may look a bit old, but they have everything they need and know how to use it. The doctor successfully treated the root canals and explained everything I needed to know. I'm quite picky, but I had no reason to doubt their professionalism. It's significantly cheaper here than most clinics in Phuket, and they have their own doctor, who you can always talk to; they don't bring in freelance doctors.

My dentist referred me to this clinic because I needed specific treatment (preparing the base for my crown).
She's a very gentle dentist who explains each step clearly.
I highly recommend her without hesitation; she's very professional!
I know where to go for specific treatments now!
Top-notch cleanliness and hygiene!
I dreaded my first root canal, but it was completely unnecessary. I was given anesthesia that could have knocked out a horse, and felt nothing. 12,000 THB.

text: I was pleased with the clinic's prices, compared to clinics in Chalong and the south in general. They quoted me 35,000 baht there, but here it was 22,000 (root canal + crown). I could have gotten it even cheaper if I'd chosen a less …

Wonderful clinic and doctors. I came in with severe pain, and they saw me and treated my root canals the same day. Other clinics only scheduled appointments a week later. Painless and professional, thank you from the bottom of my heart! They even sing during the appointments.

A clinic with professional equipment and excellent doctors. We had fillings and an ultrasonic cleaning done here, and we were very pleased with everything. The prices, by the way, are much cheaper than in Moscow.

So, what they did and how much it cost? They cleaned two canals, removed the nerve, put in a temporary filling, and a pain injection cost 4,500 baht. A week later, they put in a permanent filling for another 2,500 baht. The tooth was completely dead, and the hole was huge. It's up to you to judge. Another bonus: the doctor sings a song to you during the procedure, which is calming and puts you at ease.
I had a cleaning and four fillings done here. Overall, everything was fine, the service and equipment were excellent. And yes, the doctor really does sing songs.
I'm very happy with the service. The doctors speak English. They don't push anything unnecessary. The cleanings are high-quality. The prices are reasonable.
The teeth cleaning went great. They'll give you anesthesia if needed. It cost 900 baht. The doctor speaks English.
I have been going to this clinic ever since I moved to Phuket. I think it's great because the service is good, the treatment is thorough, and the number of follow-up visits is minimal.
I've been getting dental work done here for many years, and the dentist has taken excellent care of me. Thank you very much, doctor. 🙏 …
I had root canal treatment for 12,000 B. The appointment lasted an hour and a half. My mouth almost burst. They burned my lower lip. Now I have a scar on my lip.

I recommend this place to all tourists who have problems with toothaches. The staff is highly qualified. I was treated by a female doctor who sings, as others have written. I forgot to ask her name. I'm very pleased. If I have any problems in Phuket again, I'll definitely go to her.

Excellent clinic! I got a hygienic cleaning for 1,000 baht.
Definitely recommend!
